names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 9167, «Гавриил (Игошкин), архимандрит, исп.», with the rank and office words left off.

death.note: The year the calendar's day line prints after his name: «Прп. Гавриила исп (1959)».

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 5 октября ст. ст. — «Прп. Гавриила исп (1959).»
source.note: «Исп.» is confessor, not martyr: he outlived Stalin. No rank is recorded, the day's one polyeleos icon standing before the synaxis of the hierarchs of Moscow and not before this line.

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's own 18 octombrie was not read (2026-10-04); the Romanian calendar does not generally keep the Russian confessors of the Soviet period.
Not checked: saint.gr/10/18 was not read for him (2026-10-04).
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs's Prologue page for civil 18 October 2026 was not read (2026-10-04).
